timeline.do: Open the app. Read the bias and plan. Set price alerts at each entry and stop-loss.
Pre-open. Place no market orders. Note where your stocks are indicated to open.
WAIT. Opening 15 min is the most volatile. Cancel any stock that opens above its T1 or below its SL.
STOCK BUY WINDOW. Buy only if price is holding above the entry and the 15-min opening high. Place the SL order immediately.
OPTIONS WINDOW. Spreads / ATM buys only if the index respects the support/resistance shown. Iron condor / fly only after 10:00 with the index inside the range.
No new stock entries. If it did not trigger, skip it.
Option BUYERS: exit by 15:00 if target not hit (time decay). Spreads/condors: hold only if still inside the plan.
DAY 2. Book half at T1, trail SL to entry. EXIT everything still open by 15:15 (this is a 1–2 day setup).
Do not hold short options into the last hour of expiry day.

golden_rules: Only grade A/B stocks. C = watch, don't trade.
Stop-loss order goes in the moment you buy. Never move it down.
Risk max 1% of capital per trade, max 3 open trades.
No trigger in the buy window = no trade. Missing a trade costs nothing.
If the app's live hit-rate (Learning tab) drops below its backtest, cut size in half.
